primitives.name: Center Snap Kinematics
primitives.verbatim_quote: The movement should be more in the nature of a snap of the fingers and wrist, than a pass of the arms.
primitives.assumptions: Point-mass approximation, rigid-body impulse transfer, constant angular velocity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Nonlinear torque saturation at extreme wrist angles.

primitives.name: Center Stability Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: He must assume a good, strong position, ready to resist a charge from the front or a pull in the same direction.
primitives.assumptions: Static equilibrium under external force vector, friction threshold model.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Coulomb friction failure at peak lateral load.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Defensive pressure impact on center positioning. GSE: Run-block integrity metrics.

primitives.name: Ball-Tracking Velocity Matching
primitives.verbatim_quote: The center must follow the ball all the time; wherever the ball is, there the center must be also.
primitives.assumptions: Constant relative velocity between center and ball carrier, no deceleration lag.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Velocity mismatch exceeding human reaction threshold triggers misalignment.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Line mobility correlation with rushing yardage. GSE: Pre-snap center motion prediction for blocking assignments.
layer2.telemetry: Center-ball velocity differential, post-snap alignment error

primitives.name: Passing Consistency Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: A good motto to follow is : "Not too hard, not too slow; Not too high, not too low." No quarter can handle irregular passing without mistakes.
primitives.assumptions: Gaussian distributed pass parameters, zero-mean systematic bias.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Variance inflation leading to receiver drop events.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Quarterback completion probability given pass quality. GSE: Real-time pass trajectory validation for receiver routes.
layer2.telemetry: Pass accuracy standard deviation, receiver catch rate conditional on snap quality
